role: Determine whether the weak/null global environmental averages conceal reproducible multivariate species-response syndromes. This is an omnibus descriptive heterogeneity diagnostic, not a significance rescue.

analysis.main_effect_features: all five species partial-rho columns, no block selection
analysis.interaction_features: all ten beta_interaction columns, no pair selection
analysis.join: inner join by exact species string; fail unless all 369 species are present in every feature
analysis.standardization: z-score each of the 15 species-effect columns across the 369 species
analysis.pairwise_structure: complete 15x15 Spearman correlation matrix, reported descriptively without feature-wise p-values
analysis.ordination: PCA by SVD of the standardized 369x15 matrix; report all eigenvalue fractions and loadings for PC1-PC5

bootstrap_stability.procedure: species bootstrap with replacement; refit PCA; align each bootstrap component sign to the reference loading vector; report loading q10/q50/q90 and explained-variance q10/q50/q90 for PC1-PC3
bootstrap_stability.component_matching: greedy maximum absolute loading correlation with reference PC1-PC3; fail closed if a bootstrap component cannot be matched uniquely

analysis.species_scores: retain PC1-PC5 scores for later outcome-independent context joins; no clustering threshold is chosen here

special_nearmiss_rule: Thermal and atmospheric/dryness may be discussed together only as entries in the complete 15-feature matrix. Their pairwise correlation is not a confirmatory test and cannot open individual-variable decomposition.
future_context_join: After independent G5/GBIF species metadata are frozen, PC scores may be related to taxonomy, realm, occupancy/range and other predeclared external contexts in a separate contract. No such context is selected from the PCA outcome here.
forbidden: feature-wise significance tests selected from large loadings
choosing a cluster count from ecological interpretation and treating it as confirmatory
reclassifying the five-block or ten-interaction Holm results
claim_ceiling: May establish that species-level environmental response estimates covary in stable multivariate syndromes. It cannot establish adaptation, mechanism, or a globally supported environmental main effect.
